:::{#def-probability-measure}
#### Probability measure

A **probability measure** on a [measurable space](#def-measurable-space) $(\Omega, \events)$
is a [measure](#def-measure) $\P$ on $\events$
that gives the whole set $\Omega$ the value $1$:

$$\Pf{\Omega} = 1$$

Then $(\Omega, \events, \P)$ is a **probability space**,
$\Omega$ is its **sample space**,
the elements of $\Omega$ are **outcomes**,
and the sets in $\events$ are **events**.

:::
